upgrades.d: Cornered animal. Orb damage climbs as your health falls, up to +80% at death's door.
Guarded. Your orb swats enemy projectiles out of the air, even at a standstill.
The ground remembers. Half a second after each direct hit, the spot detonates for 40% of the damage.
No wind-up. Swing within a second of catching the orb and it leaves +60% faster and +35% harder.
Blood frenzy. Each kill adds speed & damage. Stacks up to 8, lost on hit.
Event horizon. The orb drags everything within 240px into itself and grinds what it catches.
Wider ruin. Every explosion, pulse and shockwave your orb makes reaches 30% further.
Cuts that linger. Direct hits apply a bleed dealing 5 damage per second for 3s.
Slippery magic. Blink dash cooldown reduced by 0.5s.
Trade up. Killing anything within 3s of being hurt restores 4 HP.
Signed in blood. Orb damage +50%, but you no longer heal between waves.
Hunter's high. Each kill boosts your movement speed by 120 for 2 seconds.
Trick shot. Every wall bounce charges the orb +15% damage, up to 5, spent on the next enemy hit.
Supercharged bolts. Lightning arc damage +5 per jump.
Arc discharge. Every hit chains lightning to up to 3 nearby foes.
Longer sparks. Lightning arc jumps 50 further to reach more enemies.
Wind it up. Hold the throw to charge it through three levels, release to let it fly -- up to 2.1x launch force and 2.2x damage on the first thing it hits. It never fires on its own.
Every 6th throw leaves burning: 2.5x damage and a crater where it lands.
Build it up. Every 10th hit of a combo detonates a free void ring around the orb.
Volatile energy. Orb critical hit chance +10% per stack.
Refined taste. Banished cards are replaced by an epic or legendary.
Shards of spite. Enemy kills shatter into 3 homing fragments each dealing 8 damage.
Bone-jarring catch. Stopping the orb with your body blasts nearby enemies, harder the faster it was going.
Soul explosion. Each kill bursts into a wide void ring dealing 18 damage.
A cursed imp binds to you. Hits enemies and marks them for extra damage.
The mark festers longer. Curse duration +1.5s.
Serrated demonic claws. Demon hit damage +5.
Amplified hex. Cursed enemies take 10% more damage from all sources.
No mercy. A direct hit on an enemy under 15% health kills it outright.
Shockwave on impact. Each hit blasts nearby enemies for 12 damage.
Nothing to carry. Move speed +40%, but max HP -30%.
A better hand. Gain 2 more rerolls right now.
Spalling. Wall bounces shed two cutting shards that fly off and carve anything they meet.
Chill to the bone. Hit an enemy twice in 3s to freeze them solid for 2s.
Cold shatter. A frozen enemy that dies bursts into an ice nova, damaging and chilling the rest.
Icy wake. Orb trail slows enemies by 65% while they stand in it.
All or nothing. Orb deals 2x damage but shatters if it hits a wall.
Dragnet. A recalled orb hauls every enemy it passes along behind it.
Dense iron core. Bleeds speed faster, but +20 bonus damage on every hit.
Cold touch. Every direct hit slows the enemy by 40% for 1.5 seconds.
Seeks warm flesh. Orb gently steers toward the nearest enemy.
Speed becomes power. A moving orb hits harder the faster it travels, with no upper limit -- every point of launch force you own finally counts.
Hardened body. Invincibility frames after being hit +0.12s.
Unstoppable. The orb no longer bounces off enemies -- it ploughs straight through them.
Force into armour. Every 6 orb hits you land build 8 points of shield.
Cornered. Below 30% health you take 35% less damage and deal 30% more.
Draining chill. Enemies standing in your frost trail slowly heal you for 0.5 HP/s.
Vampiric orb. Each enemy hit restores 1 HP.
Hollow crystal core. Higher top speed and much faster acceleration.
Conductive. Chain Lightning jumps to 2 more enemies and reaches 60 further.
Invisible tether. Orb slowly drifts back toward you when idle.
Distance is damage. Hits landed far from you deal +12% more per stack.
Keep the beat. You get 1.6s longer to land the next hit before the combo drops.
Rolling thunder. Orb damage +3% per point of combo, lost when the combo drops.
Sharpen your orb's impact. Orb damage +5 per hit.
Scorched earth. Orb leaves burning fire that deals 20 damage per second.
Grow the orb's mass. Size +20%, wider hitbox.
Explosive launch power. Orb launch force +100.
A shard circles you forever, striking anything it sweeps through. Weaker than your orb, but never stops.
More firepower. Another shard joins the ring.
Wider circle. Mirror Ball radius +30, covers more ground.
Dizzying spin. Mirror Ball rotation speed increases.
Build the charge. Every 5th consecutive enemy hit (no wall bounces) deals double damage.
Nothing wasted. Healing above full HP becomes a shield instead of vanishing.
A wise familiar joins you. Flies overhead and swoops on nearby enemies.
Razor-sharp claws. Owl attack damage +8.
Relentless diver. Owl attack cooldown -1s.
Keen eyes. Owl detects and attacks from 75 further away.
Mirror images. Two ghost orbs flank and mimic the main orb's path.
Spectral edge. The first enemy you hit each throw does not stop the orb -- it takes the hit and the orb carries straight on.
Brute force. Everything you hit is knocked back 40% harder per stack.
Blood in the air. Each kill makes you faster, stacking up to 10. Every hit you take costs 3 stacks.
Feeding frenzy. Each kill makes the orb 5% bigger and 4% stronger, up to 10. Shrinks back between kills.
Slow mending. Recover 1 HP every 2.5 seconds, always, even mid-fight.
Two notes, one chord. When both orbs strike the same enemy within 2s, the pair detonates for heavy damage.
Elastic bounce. Orb gains +100 speed every time it bounces off an enemy.
Cut through the veil. Enemies you pass through mid-blink take 25 damage.
Torn space. Blinking detonates for 30 damage at both the place you left and the place you arrive.
Practised hands. Catching the orb makes you invulnerable for 1 second.
A second heart, beating out of time. Max HP +40, healed immediately.
Refuse to fall. A killing blow instead leaves you at 1 HP and blasts the field. Recharges every 3 waves.
Predatory arc. After a direct hit the orb turns and flies at the next nearest enemy. +1 redirect per stack, up to 5.
Break the ice. Hitting a frozen enemy deals 3x damage.
Every second orb that returns to you fires straight back out at the nearest enemy with 50% more force.
Find the seam. Critical hits deal an extra 60% of the orb's damage, per stack.
Reaping. Every 8th enemy that dies leaves a soul that restores 6 HP.
Bound together. 35% of every hit echoes onto the nearest other enemy.
Live wire. Enemies standing close to you take 6 damage twice a second.
Skin like the old rocks. All damage you take is reduced by 20%.
Live current. Chain Lightning arcs now stun everything they touch for 0.6s.
Time distortion. A fast-moving orb crawls nearby enemies to 15% speed and bleeds them while they are stuck.
Live wire. While recalling, the cord between you and the orb cuts and slows everything it crosses.
Spite. Anything that lands a hit on you takes 22 damage and is thrown off.
Sonic impact. Wall bounces release a shockwave that stuns nearby enemies for 1.2s.
A cut of the ritual. Every third wave hands you one extra card choice.
Two of everything. A second orb joins you, swung and recalled just like the first.
Insatiable hunger. Life Steal heals +2 extra HP per hit per stack.
Close feeding. Anything that dies near you gives back 2 HP.
Faster pulsing. Void ring fires 0.2s sooner each stack.
Rhythmic void energy. Orb releases a damage ring every 1.2s.
Expanding void. Pulse ring radius +20 on each release.
Delayed charge. When recalled, the orb detonates for 20 damage in a burst around itself.
A shell of old magic. Absorbs one hit completely, then rebuilds itself over 14 seconds.
Fortify your body. Max HP +10, healed immediately.
Light-footed magic. Move speed +20, dodge faster.

achievements.d: Clear a wave past wave 3 without being hit.
Clear 5 waves in a row without being hit.
Reach wave 10 without taking a single hit.
Take 20 upgrades in a single run.
Take 40 upgrades in a single run.
Have the owl and the demon at once.
Reach wave 10 without rerolling or banishing.
Survive 10 minutes in a single run.
Have four Mirror Ball shards orbiting at once.
Shatter a Glass Cannon orb 50 times.
Ghost through 50 enemies with Phase Shot.
Catch your orb 100 times in a single run.
Recall your orb 50 times in a single run.
Get blown up by a kamikaze skeleton.
Let one vampire drink from near death back to full health.
Die within 30 seconds of starting a run.
Die within 3 seconds of Second Wind saving you.
Clear a wave sitting on exactly 1 HP.
Get your orb 1500px away from you.
Kill at least one of every enemy type.
Redirect a single throw through 5 enemies.
Clear a wave without landing a single orb hit.
Nuke your orb while it is sitting in your hand.
Raise a Forcefield with no enemies anywhere near you.
Die while your Decoy is still out there running.
Rewind into less health than you started with.
Reroll the same hand 5 times in one wave.
Banish 10 cards in a single run.
Reach wave 8 having taken 5 upgrades or fewer.
Die on the exact wave you last died on.
Land a hit carrying a full five-bounce Carom charge.
Land an orb hit 1,000px away from yourself.
Plough through 6 enemies in one throw as a Juggernaut.
Deal 500 damage with a single orb hit.
Deal 2,000 damage with a single orb hit.
Drag 12 enemies into a single Singularity.
Clear a wave past wave 5 in under 20 seconds.
Call down a Meteor with no enemies anywhere.
Recall an orb that is already in your hands.
Stand perfectly still for 45 seconds with enemies alive.
Get hit by three different enemies within two seconds.
Spend more than four minutes on a single wave.
Harvest a soul while already on full health.
Clear a wave under every modifier.
Clear a Blood Moon wave without being hit.
Get killed by an enemy you had already killed.
Reach wave 10 without taking a single upgrade.
Reach wave 50 without taking a single upgrade.
Reach wave 100 without taking a single upgrade.
Kill a boss without being hit that wave.
Kill both bosses in a single run.
Clear a wave of every composition.
Clear a Siege without being hit.
Punch through a bulwark's shield with raw speed.

abilities.d: Raise a dome nothing can enter. Enemies inside are shoved out, and none can follow, for 6 seconds.
Detonate your orb: 220 damage in a huge radius plus massive knockback, growing with the wave. The orb reforms after 5 seconds.
Send out a double that sprints away. Enemies chase it instead of you for 6 seconds.
Crawl the world to a quarter speed for 5 seconds. You are unaffected.
Your orb swells into a comet for 10 seconds: triple size, 3.6x damage, and it ploughs straight through enemies AND scenery.
Snap back to where you stood 3 seconds ago and restore the health you had then.
Call down a meteor on the largest group of enemies. 195 damage in a wide crater, growing with the wave, one second after the sky opens.
Plant a crystal sentry that fires on the nearest enemy for 12 seconds, twice a second, hitting for 28 a shot and growing with the wave.
Tear a hole in the world. Everything nearby is dragged in for 3 seconds, then it collapses for 140 damage, growing with the wave.
Call a storm. For 5 seconds, lightning hammers the crowd three times a second -- 34 to what it hits and 15 to everything beside it, growing with the wave.
Freeze every enemy on screen solid for 4 seconds. They cannot move, attack or detonate.
Brace. Gain 60 shield and take half damage for 8 seconds.

modifiers.d: The horde is faster and hits harder. Kills are worth more.
Far more of them, far more fragile, and they arrive fast.
Thick-skinned and slow. Bring something that hits hard.
Every single one wears a crown. There are fewer of them.
Everything you kill explodes. Mind where you are standing.
They hit harder, but every kill pays double.
Everything here breeds. Kill them somewhere with room.
They come in a constant stream and never stop arriving.

archetypes.d: Outlast it. You start tougher, and the armour finds you first.
archetypes.tag: Forgiving. The one to learn a new wave on.

archetypes.d: Nothing is hit once. Arcs, pulses and rings, spreading outward.
archetypes.tag: Strong into crowds, thin against a single big body.

archetypes.d: Never where it swings. Faster feet, a shorter blink, and hits that pick their moment.
archetypes.tag: Rewards movement. Punishes standing still hardest of the four.

archetypes.d: Hit it until it stops. A heavier orb, and everything it touches goes flying.
archetypes.tag: The most damage per hit, and the least room for error.

compositions.d: Armour, and plenty of it. Few, slow, and very hard to move.
All of it is airborne, all of it shoots, and none of it will come to you.
Everything here is faster than you and none of it stops.
They are keeping each other alive. Decide what dies first.
Everything on this wave either explodes or divides. Mind where you stand.
Nothing but casters. Every one of them is reaching for your feet.

difficulties.d: Weaker foes, room to breathe, and a deeper bag of rerolls.
The ritual as it was written. The intended fight.
They come faster, hit harder, and the wave's respite is thin.
